address: 199 Cuba Street, Te Aro, Wellington, 6011, New Zealand
bio: This place is inspired by the laid-back Venetian taverns or bàcari that serve small glasses of wine, known as ombra in Venetian slang. Pair your favourite drinks with bite-sized snacks such as baccalà mantecato: creamy salted cod paste on toasted bread. Ombra, however, isn't only a great spot for drinks and finger food, but also for a meal. The risotto, pasta, fish and meat dishes on the menu come in portions generous enough for sharing.
